description: This file defines the TerminationReasonController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the PTO module's plugin for managing termination reasons. It extends an abstract Vue controller, manages dependencies such as the TerminationReasonConfigurationService, and prepares a Vue component with data about termination reasons in use.

classes.name: TerminationReasonController
classes.description: Controller managing termination reasons, extending a Vue-based controller, and preparing component data for the frontend.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonService
methods.description: Lazy instantiates and returns the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with termination reason data before rendering.
